checks.message: Only PROV-SITE-001 is used, labelled provisional and non-statutory; all dependent metrics inherit medium confidence.
All three key-area polygons are disclosed as provisional design indices, not verified station, park, parcel, or approval boundaries.
Conceptual land-use polygons use shared edges, cover the submitted site boundary, and do not overlap; statutory land use remains unverified.
Offline visualization contains no remote resources, scripts, forms, iframe, fetch, analytics, or executable content.
Chinese primary proposal, rendered report, visualization, five figures, A3 booklet, and A0 boards each have a complete English counterpart.
Deployment readiness is explicitly 0/6; this check validates honest disclosure and does not claim field or implementation readiness.
Personas, walking audits, interviews, operators, budgets, and approvals are identified as future verification work, never as completed participation.
FAR, height, density, setbacks, road redlines, ownership, utilities, heritage controls, and implementation budget remain unknown where official evidence is absent.
